name: tidelight
scope: Flooded cloisters and chapel-like water spaces using original bounded translucent water shaders, submerged existing stone, moving caustic highlights and pooled arrow/footstep/teleport ripples. Quest caps visible water surfaces and avoids reflection render passes; AR disables fictional world water. Rosefire, First Bell, Oath, saves, combat and existing routes remain intact.
saveCompatibility: No save keys, generator state, collision floors or scored progression are changed. Existing v0.9+ checkpoints and permanent profiles continue through their existing validated envelopes.
hardwareStatus: Desktop/browser and automated WebXR policy checks are used for publication. Physical Quest 3 comfort, thermal behavior and sustained frame rate still require hardware playtesting.
